crossRefs.note: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a…
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

translations.web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
translations.bsb: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.
translations.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
translations.asv: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.
